peak.how: MODELLED static working-set proxy, not a measured source peak. physiochemical_protein: N=45730 full raw rows, F=9; nominal train rows rounded up to 30487. TabPFN v3 source defaults E=128, CLS=4, D=512, ICL layers=24, distribution/column blocks=3/3, inducing points=128. Weights proxy=233289807 B, published serialized tabpfn-v3-regressor-v3_default.ckpt size at HF 24a16a89d245878b846555110985634aa2e656d7; not a device measurement or the original run's checkpoint digest. Assume 2 B activations, 4 B grouped inputs, 8 hidden-width live slots and 314572800 B context/allocator slack. Inference = weights + slack + 9877680 B grouped input (4*N*F*6) + 884736 B inducing hidden (2*3*F*128*128) + max(54525952 B column work [2*8*min(N,2048)*(F+4)*128], 374620160 B ICL work [2*8*N*512]). DiagScale: max(adapted inference 933295871 B, training 1709505359 B); training = weights + slack + 4320000 B grouped inputs for 2 views at T=min(ceil(train rows),10000)=10000 + 890880000 B saved layer checkpoints [2*2*T*(6*(F+4)*128+24*512)] + 266240000 B live work [2*8*T*(F+4)*128] + 202752 B for 12672 diagonal parameters and gradients/Adam moments (16 B/parameter). Peak=1709505359 B. The 96 configurations and 2 validation/8 test views do not multiply resident inference weights: configurations and single-device forwards are sequential. Default architecture, raw feature width, mixed precision, live slots and activation checkpointing are explicit proxy assumptions; checkpoint-internal configs, preprocessing/search differences, transient attention/compiler workspaces and allocator peaks were not measured. Inputs/arithmetic: survey/sol-tabular-ttc/memory-model.json sha256 acb358d5b1bbb2dbf664344262fc3f549c0031abd6a86b109ba64762416e0dc7.
